params.name: search
params.description: String you would like to search for in the `searchFields` parameter.

params.name: searchFields
params.description: A list of the fields where you want to search for the `search` parameters. e.g. ?searchFields[]=name&searchFields[]=displayname

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of items to return per request. Defaults to `10`.

params.name: updatedAfter
params.description: Only return locations that have been updated after the given date.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Retrieves the page of items that comes after the `cursor`.

items.docs:
List of all the locations that the caller has access to.

If the `cursor` parameter is used then all other parameters will be ignored. This is to avoid confusion if passing both a `cursor` and other parameters which would change what data is being returned.

Required scope: `read_locations`.

Gets a single location by its uid.

Required scope: `read_locations`.

Update a single location by its uid. 

Required scope: `write_locations`.

Be aware: The `addressDetails` property follows the ISO convention. You might see errors

if trying to update a location's address with an invalid address.

items.docs:
List of all the users that belong to any of the locations that the caller has access to.

If the `cursor` parameter is used then all other parameters will be ignored. This is to avoid confusion if passing both a `cursor` and other parameters which would change what data is being returned.

Required scope: `read_users`.
